class.name: WaifuTest
class.brief_description: Sample class provided by the [code]waifu_test[/code] engine module.
class.description: A minimal class used to verify that a custom C++ engine module is compiled into the binary, registered with [ClassDB] and reachable from scripting. It exposes a greeting, an accumulating counter and a static helper.

method.name: accumulate
method.description: Adds [param amount] to the counter and returns its new value. Emits [signal counter_changed].

method.name: fibonacci
method.description: Returns the [param n]-th number of the Fibonacci sequence, starting at [code]0[/code]. Returns [code]0[/code] and prints an error if [param n] is negative.

method.name: get_counter
method.description: Returns the current value of the counter.

method.name: greet
method.description: Returns [member greeting] addressed to [param name], punctuated according to [member mood].

method.name: reset
method.description: Sets the counter back to [code]0[/code]. Emits [signal counter_changed] only if the counter was not already [code]0[/code].

members.member: The word used to open a greeting returned by [method greet].
How the greeting returned by [method greet] is punctuated.

signal.name: counter_changed
signal.description: Emitted whenever the counter changes, with its new [param value].

constants.constant: Greetings end with an exclamation mark.
Represents the size of the [enum Mood] enum.
